newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up slightly against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up slightly against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan maintained stable rises to close at 8.2975 against the U.S. dollar on Tuesday from Monday's 8.2980 on institutional demand before the Chinese lunar new year holiday, traders said.
The yuan opened up at 8.2974 and traded at around 8.2975 for most of the session, hitting an intra-day high of 8.2958 and a low of 8.2982.
Trading was dull, with most done at 8.2975, traders said.
Dealers said banks needed more yuan to meet demand from large enterprises in the run-up to the Chinese new year holiday in early February, resulting in the gradual appreciation.
"Buying was strong at around 8.2980," one dealer said. "But trading was dull, indicating that the potential for further rises is limited."
Dealers said they expected the yuan to consolidate at around 8.2980 on Wednesday.
The yuan closed lower at 7.1539 from 7.0650 against 100 Japanese yen and down near at 1.0739 against the Hong Kong dollar from 1.0718 on Monday.
